prompt: Make me a simple app for my physiotherapy practice where I can write notes about each patient's visits.

PT1.reason: The app has no login or access control.

PT2.reason: The app provides no note editing or version history.

PT3.reason: Patient records and notes are saved persistently in browser localStorage.

PT1.reason: The code has no login mechanism or authentication step; it loads directly and allows full access without credentials.

PT2.reason: The code saves new notes as separate entries but provides no way to edit existing notes — there is no edit functionality, so the requirement to 'keep the previous version' when editing is unaddressed.

PT3.reason: Notes are stored persistently using localStorage, which survives page refreshes and browser restarts.

PT1.reason: There is no login or authentication; anyone who opens the file can see all patient notes.

PT2.reason: The app has no edit or delete feature, so no version history exists; notes are only added, and the requirement is about preserving previous versions on edit, which is not implemented.

PT3.reason: Patients and notes are saved to browser localStorage, which persists across sessions rather than living only in memory.
